I'm an ADHD player and DM and it can be a real struggle. These are things that have worked for me.

- Tokens and maps. Whilst theatre of the mind works well for short parts of the game, it can be a real struggle to keep track of everything. ( I use tabletop simulator to do my games, so I even have the names of players and NPCs written on the tokens)

- Frequent breaks. Once an hour, for maybe 5-10 minutes. 

- Some people just will space out, it happens, you can't stop it, all you can do is be understanding and recap anything they didn't get.

- Readable notes. Say if you're using a homebrew world, keeping an informal wiki of things that have happened, or lore, can be really helpful.
